responsibility: This file implements utility routines for locating executables or other files relative to GCC-managed prefix lists. It supports debug tracing, searches absolute names and ordered prefix chains with optional host executable suffixes, maintains prefix lists and maximum prefix lengths, and populates those lists from environment variables or PATH-like strings. It is the path-resolution helper layer used by GCC driver-style code to find subordinate tools and files.
same_name_distinction: Implements the path-search behavior: debug control, absolute and prefix-based lookup, prefix-list mutation, and environment/string parsing into search paths. The header just defines the prefix_list/path_prefix structs and declares those helpers.
